title: Invoices only when money is owed
problem: Every counter sale with a phone became a paid invoice, and dues at the counter waited for acceptance.
now: A counter sale becomes an invoice only when money is left unpaid, and it counts as accepted.
steps: Sell at the POS with a phone and pay in full
Check Invoices has no new row
Sell on due and take a payment straight away
